paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.88% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (-0.22%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.43%). Brent crude changed +5.03% to 105.24. Gold changed -0.10% to 4,136.3999. Bitcoin changed -0.74% to 82,659.5703. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.15%. Among the firms tracked, Deutsche Bank (-4.50%) and HSBC (-3.97%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: Billionaire Weston family to buy Boots in $8.9bn deal (FT Companies). Canadian owner of Loblaws and Shoppers Drug Mart to buy UK pharmacy chain from private equity firm Sycamore Partners Central banks and macro: Iran war blows near-£12bn hole in Britain’s public finances (FT World). FT estimates show inflation and soaring borrowing costs have slashed chancellor John Healey’s headroom in half Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors target Middle East despite war disruption (FT Markets). Western groups seek new investment opportunities despite chaos and heightened risks caused by conflict with Iran
